snippet.title: Turnbound Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3810040/Turnbound_Demo/
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802470/Turnbound/

Outsmart your way to freedom from a haunted board game where each session pits you against the trapped souls of other players, battling against the tiles left behind by other real players in asynchronous PvP battles. It’s a game of competitive inventory management, where every tile you place in your grid has a strategic cause-and-effect loop that ripples through battles and rewards those with foresight and creativity.
